title: A tier's row opens its page on the Pricing tab with a breadcrumb
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • A page opens, not a dialog, on the Pricing tab.
  • The breadcrumb reads Pricing › Tiers › and tier A's name, starting at Pricing with no Settings crumb before it.
  • The page has a Pricing tab and a Customers tab.
  • Tier A's number shows as plain text beside its name.
